name: Megami Aiko's Guide to Murder
source:
For as long as Megami can remember, she's only had one dream - to kill someone! And today's the day her dream comes true. Join her on her adventure as she explores the abandoned Anderson Elementary School and picks off her three friends, one by one. But be careful not to scare them off!

[From [url=https://funnyside.itch.io/megami-aikos-guide-to-murder]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从女神记事起，她就只有一个梦想——杀人！今天是她梦想成真的日子。和她一起踏上冒险之旅，探索废弃的安德森小学，并一一解决掉她的三个朋友。但要小心，不要吓跑他们！

[来自[url=https://funnyside.itch.io/megami-aikos-guide-to-murder]Itch.io[/url]]
